text_en: Shanghai Composite closed down 1.85%, ChiNext down 2.95%. Semiconductor and computing hardware industrial chains continued to adjust, with memory, advanced packaging, lithography machines, and CPO leading declines. Rare earth, coal, solar, lithium battery, consumer electronics, and commercial aerospace concept stocks fell sharply. AI application, consumer staples, and medical service concept stocks strengthened. Today, Hong Kong Stock Connect auto cross-border, film and TV media, A-share internet, online consumption, Hong Kong Stock Connect internet cross-border, gaming media, Shanghai-HK-Shenzhen consumer leader, and Hang Seng internet cross-border sectors broadly strengthened, with Hong Kong Stock Connect auto cross-border targets leading the market: Hong Kong Stock Connect auto cross-border sector: Hong Kong Stock Connect Auto ETF E Fund rose 4.14% leading the market, Hong Kong Stock Connect Auto ETF GF rose 2.90%, and Hong Kong auto-themed cross-border products surged. Film and TV media sector: Film ETF Guotai rose 4.02%, Entertainment & Film.
